membership_rule: Includes national-level, capital-intensive manufacturing or adoption incentive policies explicitly targeted at heavy commercial transport (buses/trucks) or foundational EV supply chains in India. Excludes state-level policies and minor amendments to existing passenger vehicle schemes.
